## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? Link the issue it closes. -->

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] `feat` — new feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `style` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build` — tooling, deps, or pipeline
- [ ] **Breaking change** (note the migration below)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] A [changeset](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) is included if a published package changed
- [ ] Accessibility verified (keyboard nav, focus, `prefers-reduced-motion`, contrast)
- [ ] No unintended visual regressions (Lighthouse perf-diff reviewed)
- [ ] Docs / ADRs updated if behaviour or architecture changed
